acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Arachnids family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Crawler, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Six-Eye Pounce Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Dog-sized pure spider with dull brown fur, eight thin legs, six simple eyes, dripping fangs, and no humanoid torso.
Signature mechanic: Cluster Pounce: the Crawler aligns six simple eyes, lowers its dull brown abdomen, and jumps along their shared gaze.
battlefieldDuty: Probe close-range attention with one dog-sized pounce from a pure spider silhouette.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 remain spiders with no humanoid torso and carry shell valves only at existing fang, leg, abdomen, and spinneret structures; T3–T5 retain the existing humanoid torso with capillary silk garments and hand-operated reservoirs.

Affinity construction becomes hydraulic through translucent venom-separated reservoirs, coherent fill lines inside silk, wet chitin reflection, pressure jets from selected spinnerets, and visible drainage at the origin valve.
counterplay: Leave the eye line and strike the extended rear joints after landing; no humanoid torso or hand action is involved. Affinity signal: A clear reservoir fills and darkens one silk route before discharge; puncture it or open the exposed origin valve after the jet.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only blue silk or ordinary venom sheen without hydraulic construction
Glow-only water treatment without reservoirs, coherent flow, and drainage
Invented humanoid torso or hands on T1–T2 to route water
Liquid bodies that erase spider anatomy or confuse venom with Water affinity
identityInvariants: A bulbous abdomen, eight jointed legs arching around the body, clustered eyes, fangs, and spinnerets remain legible; a humanoid torso is added only from T3 onward.
Black, charcoal, deep violet, blood-red markings, pale silk white, and green, red, or amber eye accents form the source palette.
Chitin, coarse bristle, silk, bone, amber, venom sheen, and eye settings remain physically distinct family materials.
Web decorations, silk robes, egg sacs, wrapped prey, jeweled eye settings, and layered drapery communicate escalation.
Leg load, spinneret direction, fang posture, silk tension, and eye cluster alignment preserve readable attack and recovery states.
telegraph: All six eyes face one point, dripping fangs close, and the thin rear legs compress beneath the abdomen.
